about_the_game:
Born Without Rights is a third-person, story-driven action-adventure game with stealth, gunfights, and exploration. Inspired by the atmosphere and gameplay of The Last of Us and Max Payne, it blends tense encounters, detailed environments, and an engaging narrative.

You play as an ordinary man whose life changes after a chain of events brings him into conflict with an authoritarian regime. From city streets to the hidden basements of the NKVD, you will face danger, build fragile alliances, and experience a story about survival in a world without freedom.

The game is linear, with a strong focus on story, exploration, and gameplay. While the main path is fixed, minor choices can influence dialogue, scenes, and small details of the journey, making the experience more personal.

The gameplay offers a third-person action-adventure experience where you can choose to sneak past enemies, engage in close combat, or take part in tense gunfights using a variety of weapons. Combat is supported by a cover system that allows you to plan your approach in different situations.

The environments are immersive and detailed, taking you across city streets, apartments, NKVD basements, and hidden underground areas. You will meet different characters along the way, including members of the underground resistance, each with their own role in the story.

Some of the game’s mini-stories are inspired by real events, taking influence from both modern struggles and historical moments of censorship and resistance.

The experience is completed with an atmospheric soundtrack and sound design that match the tension, tone, and emotion of the world.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains content:
Depictions of violence, including physical combat and acts of brutality by military or police forces.
Depictions of state surveillance, political persecution, and authoritarian control.
Strong language and emotionally intense situations.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or Intel Core i5-2500
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon R9 380 or NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600X or Intel Core i7-7700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 or AMD RX 6700 XT
